name: asphalt_rain_reflection
promptTemplate: A rain-slicked street in {{city_palette}} tones with {{rain_intensity}} rain, {{wetness_gloss}} asphalt gloss under {{traffic_flow}} with wind at {{wind_angle}} degrees and {{steam_haze}} wet asphalt reflections.

city_palette.hint: Swaps city skyline neons and road reflections

rain_intensity.hint: Drives downpour streak count and puddle ripples

wetness_gloss.hint: Lengthens vertical light smeared on wet street

traffic_flow.hint: Changes volume of oncoming headlights and taillights

wind_angle.hint: Slants rain streaks across the horizon

steam_haze.hint: Billows glowing vapor across the asphalt

listing.blurb: Neon storefronts and car headlamps dissolve into shimmering streaks across wet asphalt as raindrops ripple across the dark projected avenue.
listing.prompt: A rain-slicked street at night seen from low down: neon signs and headlights dissolve into long streaked reflections on the wet asphalt, raindrops ringing in the puddles and shattering the reflections. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
